classes.purpose: Understand the professional question, define the answer and validation contract, and write route-specific generation instructions
classes.content: The question and facts typed or attached by the user, including names or other personal facts when material; inferred legal, tax, or compliance framing; answer contract including document type, validation scope, correction policy, and professional-judgment policy; generation route and instructions; source-domain sidecars; diagnostics and review decisions

external_boundaries.purpose: Curate qualified source domains for the confirmed legal framework and issue
external_boundaries.content: Legal or tax issue research terms and public-source URLs; queries can reflect case facts when the selected model runtime uses them
controls: The selected model runtime chooses domains from the confirmed framework; deterministic scripts do not choose legal sources.
The workflow does not request credentials or authenticated-source access.
